description: Use this when the user attaches a screen recording or video of a process (MP4 or WebM) and asks RuleFoundry to extract, capture or document the business logic in it. RuleFoundry transcribes the recording, reads it and writes cited business logic into a Project knowledge base that coding agents can read. Counts as one Extraction of the workspace allowance. Confirm the topic with the user and set confirmExtract to true. Reuse the same idempotencyKey only to retry the same request. Processing takes a few minutes; check it with rulefoundry_get_recording_extraction.

confirmExtract.description: True only after the user confirmed sending this recording to RuleFoundry.

description.description: Optional context: who is speaking, what to focus on.

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque key for this request. Reuse it only for retries of the same request.

projectId.description: Optional existing Project the user manages. Omit to create a Project titled from the topic.

recording.description: The recording file the user attached in ChatGPT (MP4 or WebM, up to 256 MiB and 60 minutes).

topic.description: What the recording shows, confirmed by the user.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace for a new Project; the personal workspace when omitted.

name: rulefoundry_extract_from_recording
title: Extract business logic from a recording
